questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Really difficult. I looked for months, but then luckily was accepted into uni accommodation

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Start looking early to find cheaper options. The uni wont answer if you have a place until like august thirty first, so a bit stressful.

questions.answer: Very easy

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: A desk that signed everybody in

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Got two out of three of the ones i wanted. Last one overlapped in timetable.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Not hard at all, just check email daily in the beginning

questions.answer: Pharmacology 3, Mechanisms of brain development 3 and physiology 3

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: For example joining the Scandinavian society to bond with other scandis living abroad and get a taste of home.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: The highlands are a must. Lots of day trips and weekend trips being planned there. And also see Glasgow, just about an hour by train.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Almost all students I was with were other internationals. A lot of people from all over Britain especially but also just from all over the world so it’s easy to find people in the same situation as you.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Walking around the city is much easier than you’d think.
The academic level is definitely not easier than at home.
The nature is absolutely stunning and worth the effort and time to go explore.

questions.answer: Getting away from ucph and Copenhagen for a while was a healthy experience
